cases.scenario: An evidence record claims automated_tested without recording a method or any source reference.
cases.current_schema_observation: Shape-valid by schema inspection because method and source_refs are optional for every evidence state.
cases.required_oracle: A strong evidence state must not be accepted without enough explicit support to reconstruct how that state was established.
cases.recommended_test: Assert this fixture is rejected, or explicitly document and test a different reconstructable support mechanism.

cases.scenario: An integration receipt marks a packet accepted even though one constitutional root is explicitly assessed as conflict.

reasons: Accepted despite an unresolved constitutional conflict.

cases.current_schema_observation: Shape-valid by schema inspection because decision is not conditionally constrained by root assessments.
cases.required_oracle: Canonical acceptance must not silently coexist with an explicit constitutional root conflict. If a conflict can ever be integrated, the semantics and reason must be explicit and root-grounded rather than accidental schema permissiveness.
cases.recommended_test: At minimum reject accepted + root assessment conflict unless Lane 01 establishes a different explicit constitutional semantic.

cases.scenario: A deferred integration emits a new resulting state revision.
cases.current_schema_observation: Shape-valid by schema inspection because resulting_state_revision is independent of decision.
cases.required_oracle: Decision and revision effect must be coherent enough that replay cannot infer two incompatible meanings from one receipt.
cases.recommended_test: Reject non-null resulting_state_revision for rejected/deferred/repair_requested decisions; define explicit semantics for partially_integrated.

cases.scenario: An occupancy is marked active while also carrying an ended_at timestamp.
cases.current_schema_observation: Shape-valid by schema inspection because status and ended_at are not conditionally coupled.
cases.required_oracle: A replacement occupant must be able to determine whether a prior occupancy is active or ended without guessing from contradictory fields.
cases.recommended_test: Require active => ended_at null/absent and ended => ended_at present; define recovery semantics separately for abandoned/expired occupancy if needed.
